VirtualDesktopAccessor.dll
==========================

Source:  https://github.com/Ciantic/VirtualDesktopAccessor
License: MIT, Copyright (c) Jari Pennanen

Prebuilt binary copied from C:\Warez\VirtualDesktopAccessor (the copy the old
VirtualDesktopLoop.ahk script used). SHA-256:
8740C572A1C000E3B87FFEB1E4C397EAE9AF3BD4A2ABDC3BCFFACAB4493F8FF5

It uses undocumented Windows internals and can break on a new Windows build.
aestoys checks it against the registry before every jump and falls back to
plain key presses when it disagrees or is missing. To stop using it, delete
VirtualDesktopAccessor.dll next to aestoys.exe.
